name: Antarctic Peninsula
about: Cruises run Nov–Mar only. Dec–Jan brings penguin chicks and 24hr daylight; Feb–Mar is best for whales as ice retreats.
overview: The seventh continent — vast ice shelves, penguin colonies by the hundreds of thousands, and whales surfacing beside the ship.
costOverview: Antarctica has no budget version — even the cheapest shoulder-season expedition cruise starts near five figures, and most trips run well beyond that once flights and gear are added.

costItems.label: Premium ship with kayaking and camping

As sea ice retreats, whale sightings become more frequent.
